mutations.label: unused-names: the test files go to biome a hundred at a time
mutations.only: ^(?:a file past the first hundred is read, and each batch gives its own verdict)$

mutations.label: unused names: a finding in plugin/ or scripts/ fails the run
mutations.only: ^an unused name in product is a finding, named by file$

mutations.label: unused names: an unused import in a test fails the run
mutations.only: ^an unused name in tests is a finding, named by file$

mutations.label: unused names: ruff's own count of findings is a finding
mutations.only: ^an unused name in python is a finding, named by file$

mutations.label: unused names: in tests/ only imports are read
mutations.only: ^a local inside a test is not a finding: only its imports are read$

mutations.label: unused names: a linter that cannot start is UNRUN, never clean
mutations.from: echo "unused-names: UNRUN — a linter could not run"; exit 3
mutations.to: echo "unused-names: UNRUN — a linter could not run"; exit 0
mutations.only: ^with no tools on PATH it is UNRUN, naming each linter, never clean$

mutations.label: unused names: a class with no file is UNRUN
mutations.from: echo "UNRUN: no $class file was listed to read."; unrun=1
mutations.only: ^a tree with no file of a class read nothing there, which is UNRUN, not clean$

mutations.label: unused names: a tool with no verdict of its own is UNRUN, not a finding
mutations.from: echo "UNRUN: $1 exited $rc without a verdict of its own."
mutations.only: ^a linter that is present but cannot start is UNRUN, never a finding$

mutations.label: unused names: only the pinned ruff is used
mutations.only: ^a ruff that is not the pinned version is not used$

mutations.label: unused names: a path git quotes is named as unread
mutations.from: '"'*) echo "UNRUN: git quoted a path this cannot read: $f"; unrun=1; continue ;;
mutations.only: ^a path git quotes is named as unread, not skipped$

mutations.label: unused names: every .py file is read
mutations.only: ^an unused name in python is a finding, named by file$

mutations.label: unused names: a verdict is the tool's own summary line
mutations.only: ^a verdict is the tool's own summary line, not its words anywhere in the output$

mutations.label: unused names: a statement nothing can reach is a finding in plugin/ and scripts/ (ADR-119 T4)
mutations.only: ^an unreachable statement is a finding, and its clean twin is not$
